name: design-feedback
description: Collaborative visual feedback tool for design reviews

scripts.deploy: npm run build && cd worker && wrangler deploy
scripts.db:create: cd worker && wrangler d1 create design-feedback-db
scripts.db:migrate: cd worker && wrangler d1 migrations apply design-feedback-db
scripts.db:migrate:local: cd worker && wrangler d1 migrations apply design-feedback-db --local
